upstream.description: Samples using AI and Azure SQL DB

classification.analysis: SQL-AI-samples is Microsoft's official collection of sample notebooks, scripts, and end-to-end projects showing how to build AI applications on Azure SQL Database, covering vector embeddings and similarity search (Cognitive Search, FAISS, Redis/ACRE, custom IVFFlat/KMeans indexes), RAG chatbots (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PromptFlow), NL2SQL agents, content moderation, and an MSSQL MCP server for agent tool access. It's organized as a grab-bag reference repo of Jupyter notebooks and small standalone projects (many linking out to sibling Azure-Samples repos) rather than a single cohesive product, aimed at developers integrating Azure OpenAI/AI Search with SQL-backed data. It's steadily maintained with periodic additions rather than fast-moving, reflecting its role as a documentation/sample companion to Azure SQL AI features.

use_cases.title: Learn how to generate and query vector embeddings directly from Azure SQL Database
Build a NL2SQL chatbot over your own Azure SQL data with LangChain
Connect an AI agent to an MSSQL database via the official MCP server
Compare FAISS, Redis, and native SQL vector indexing approaches on the same dataset
